prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.decodeHex = function(text), returning an array of byte numbers or null
Behavior: Decode pairs of ASCII hexadecimal digits, accepting upper or lower case. Reject odd length, non-ASCII, or any non-hex digit; empty input succeeds with an empty byte sequence.
Visible example: "4A00ff" produces bytes [74, 0, 255].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
